ItemId.description: The code's 26-character id; omit it to match by code or create one.

Code.description: The short unique code, such as REG.

Kind.description: What the line pays for: Regular, Overtime, DoubleTime, Holiday, PaidTimeOff, PredictabilityPay, CallBack, ShiftDifferential, Unpaid, Weekend, Salary, Bonus, Commission, Tips, or a kind a module registers.

Multiplier.description: What the hourly rate is multiplied by, 0 to 10.

PremiumPerHour.description: A premium paid an hour on top.

ExportCode.description: The code an outside payroll system knows the line by.

Enabled.description: Whether the code is in use.

Properties.description: Module settings, such as WorkforcePayCodeSettings (WindowStart, WindowEnd, Weekdays) for a shift differential, and PayrollPayCodeSettings (Calculation, BaseCodeIds, TaxTreatment by tax category, Supplemental, CountsInRegularRate, CountsAsHoursWorked, PeriodLimit, YearLimits with EffectiveFrom and Amount, LifetimeLimit, Priority, Arrears, Proration, InRetroPay, FormBoxes).

Codes.description: The pay codes to create, or update by id or code.
